summary.headline: Lord of the Ascendant in the Houses
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of the Moon’s applications and separations from the planets, including the native’s condition through the Moon’s sign, house, lord, strength, and planetary applications. The lord of the ascendant is interpreted in each of the twelve houses for honor, wealth, siblings, parents, children, labor, marriage, travel, kings, friends, and enemies.
